assumptions: cases is an exact ObservedCase[]; outer design data must not be passed into observedCaseSchema. All splits are search/development, never held out.

10 families represent distinct operational intents and contract decision mechanisms. They are not proof of statistical/semantic independence; both variants share one family, and all tasks share only two deterministic capabilities.
Every task requests exactly one existing capability and its complete existing schema. Secondary context is explicit background; no new executor behavior or multi-capability composition is required.
Stats inputs are flat names; only lowercase .txt/.md are scanned; JSON and uppercase .MD are excluded. Empty text files remain file entries.
Stats words use JavaScript whitespace splitting, not language-specific segmentation; bytes are UTF-8; lines split LF and exclude phantom final line; headings count startsWith("#"), including fences.
Changed output follows the current literal implementation, preserves entries and order, counts duplicates and deleted entries, and uses case-sensitive test precedence before extensions.
Changed-file schema minItems=1 excludes an empty changed list despite classifyChanges([]) accepting it; empty manifest is intentionally not labeled as a positive acceptance case.
summary.total is the total input entry count, not a per-category aggregation. Per-category counts are review-only caseDesign metadata, not output fields.
Rationale and markers are review metadata and should not be exposed to the router or placed inside strict ObservedCase objects. ExpectedChoice/schema/expected remain evaluator-only.
No real model is called. Gold outputs are computed deterministically from existing contracts; no independent custody or formal evaluation claim is made.

families.name: 传输字节预算核对
families.rationale: 检查传输配额所依据的 UTF-8 字节与可见字符并不等价；重音组合、汉字和 emoji 改变 bytes 而不要求新的处理能力。
families.distinctDecision: 传输编码成本核对：原样读取文本，保留 UTF-8 多字节和组合字符。

families.name: 记录终止符核对
families.rationale: 目标是排查导出记录尾行和 CRLF 框架，区分空行、末尾换行和未终止记录，不是文档篇幅改写。
families.distinctDecision: LF 记录边界：保留空行，末尾 LF 不制造额外行，CRLF 中 CR 属于字节。

families.name: 空白词法扫描核对
families.rationale: 目标是验证索引分词器的空白边界，标点和连续汉字不拆分；与编码、换行和标题任务有独立词法规则。
families.distinctDecision: 空白词法：tab、NBSP、全角空格为分隔符，标点与汉字连续串不拆。

families.name: 轻量标题扫描器验收
families.rationale: 目标是验证现成行首 # 扫描器，而不是要求 Markdown AST；围栏内、无空格 # 与缩进 # 的差别是新判别机制。
families.distinctDecision: 标题词法：任何第一列 # 均计数，包括围栏内和无空格文本；缩进 # 不计。

families.name: 附件完整性与合计对账
families.rationale: 目标是检查零内容附件是否仍登记和多文件合计能否对账；文件数不是文本长度、也不是变更路径数量。
families.distinctDecision: 附件完整性：空 .txt/.md 仍占一个 files 项；非文本附件不入统计，files 排序。

families.name: 测试资源归属审计
families.rationale: 目标是确定测试目录里的各种资源属于测试所有权；测试路径优先级覆盖 docs/config/source 扩展名。
families.distinctDecision: 测试归属优先：/tests/ 和 /__tests__/ 段将文档、配置、二进制资源归入 test。

families.name: 文件后缀与目录名冲突核对
families.rationale: 目标是排查按目录猜类别的错误；配置目录里的源码、源码目录里的文档由实际后缀决定。
families.distinctDecision: 后缀分派：source/docs/config 等词出现在目录名不构成类别规则。

families.name: 测试命名迁移审计
families.rationale: 目标是检查 .test 命名迁移的精确模式，不能把 .spec、.test.ts 或大写后缀按广义测试语义推断。
families.distinctDecision: 精确测试命名：仅 .test.[cm]?js 命名模式；.test.ts 和 .spec.js 仍按源码扩展名。

families.name: 清单条目守恒对账
families.rationale: 目标是确认汇总是输入条目计数而非去重路径、只选 modified 或磁盘现存文件；changeType 不影响分类。
families.distinctDecision: 条目守恒：重复路径保留、added/modified/deleted 均计入，输出原顺序，total 等于条目数。

families.name: 跨平台字面路径兼容性核对
families.rationale: 目标是检查分类器是否按输入字符串机械匹配；不规范化反斜杠、不补根斜杠、不将大小写折叠。
families.distinctDecision: 原串路径互操作：大小写敏感；反斜杠不是 /tests/ 段；顶层 tests/ 不含前导 /。
